top_signals.title: Schneider Electric Expands in AI With $22.6 Billion PTC Purchase
top_signals.summary: Schneider Electric SE said it’s buying PTC Inc. for about $22.6 billion, further expanding its portfolio of industrial software and offerings powered by artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
